entities.summary: Ion Barbu was a Romanian mathematician and poet. His name is associated with the Mathematics Subject Classification number 51C05, which is a major posthumous recognition reserved only to pioneers of investigations in an area of mathematical inquiry. As a poet, he is known for his volume Joc secund, in which he sought to fulfill his vision of a poetry which adhered to the same virtues that he found in mathematics. Ion Barbu was a logicians & mathematicians from Câmpulung (1895-03-19, Câmpulung–1961-08-11). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Ion Barbu's contributions to mathematics and his poetry volume Joc secund had a regional impact on Romanian literature and intellectual circles. His work in classification systems has been recognized posthumously with the Mathematics Subject Classification number 51C05.
